objective: Implement and verify the deterministic repository-local SDLC, protected-main, exact-SHA deployment, migration, production-readback, evidence-bundle, and bounded rollback controller required by Phase 197.
preserved_behavior: Phase 196 certified production release and exact-SHA evidence
Existing single-writer Governor event chain, leases, recovery, and sparse owner-invoked review policy
Existing application, authentication, graph, worker, database, and deployment behavior
Protected-main branch rules and provider secret-management boundaries
exclusions: No product runtime or user-interface feature
No custom CI platform, distributed scheduler, provider credential store, or consumer-chat automation
No unconditional staging, canary, backup, or rollback ceremony for low-risk releases
release_requirements: Cross-repository exact-SHA manifest for ENTRAL product and Sovereign control/website repositories
Risk-tiered migration, staging, backup, failure-injection, health, reconciliation, and rollback gates
Current origin/main reconciliation and protected-main required checks
Exact-main-SHA deployment for frontend, API, and worker
Authenticated production smoke, state readback, and reconciliation
Hashed release-evidence bundle and verified rollback point
